text:
Christopher Columbus.

And truly, what a visionary. Just as he boldly charted new waters, our corporate overlords have charted the uncharted territory of charging you more for the exact same plastic rectangle, now available in "Midnight Obsidian" instead of "Basic Black." It is nothing short of genius to convince you that your life is incomplete without a device that does the exact same things as the one in your pocket, but with a slightly glossier finish and a price tag that requires a second mortgage. We don’t just innovate; we rebrand reality. Why settle for the truth when you can have a sleek adjective?
